title: Integrate facts and managed Nix source
goal: After T001 and T002 are terminal and independently reviewed, integrate exactly their reviewed source commits in the Bureau-recorded run-scoped worktree into one reviewed non-main Heim-PC integration commit that preserves both terminal source heads as Git ancestors, prove the integration contains no unrelated source changes, and create a leased content-addressed whole-source activation artifact. T006 publishes no remote Git ref: T004 and T007 consume only its immutable artifact plus exact commit identity, while T005 remains an intentionally independent component patch. T008 later owns the only remote/main publication path.

approval.note: This task may read and mutate the exclusively reserved Heim-PC Git object/ref store only through its Bureau-recorded run-scoped worktree and local run-scoped non-main workspace branch, and may create the bound activation-source artifact. Workspace path, local branch and frozen baseline are generated and recorded by Bureau for the exact run. Integration must preserve the exact T001/T002 terminal commits as ancestors; squash, rebase or cherry-pick substitution that loses their ancestry is outside authority. No git push or remote ref mutation is authorized or required. It does not merge to main and grants no runtime, storage, EFI, firmware, reboot or production-cutover authority.

acceptance.assertion: Integration begins only after T001 and T002 are terminal and independently reviewed; evidence binds each exact terminal Git commit/tree, its reviewed task evidence and the exact common integration base. Missing, dirty, unavailable, unbound or ambiguous source identity fails closed before integration mutation.

Before reading commit/tree objects or creating local integration refs, the task holds the exclusive component.heim-pc.nixos-source-integration claim materialized as path:/home/alex/repos/heim-pc/.git; lease loss or object/ref-store drift fails closed before another Git mutation.

Before the first Git/index/tree mutation, the execution envelope contains a non-null Bureau workspace whose workspace_path, workspace_branch, baseline_commit and source_head_at_intent are bound to this exact run. All integration mutation and validation occurs only there; a missing workspace, reused fixed integration worktree, branch mismatch, dirty preimage or run/workspace identity drift fails closed.

Inside the exact run-scoped workspace, T006 creates a local non-main integration commit by ancestry-preserving Git merge operations from the exact reviewed T001 and T002 terminal commits. The final T006 commit must have both exact terminal commits as ancestors. Squash, rebase, cherry-pick or patch replay that would produce the same tree while losing either source commit as an ancestor is rejected. Any merge conflict is explicitly reviewed, and tree comparison proves the result contains the intended union plus no unrelated source delta.

Focused T001/T002 tests and required Heim-PC repository validation are green in the exact run-scoped integration worktree on the exact local integration commit/tree, and an independent review finds no material integration regression before the source artifact is created.

While holding the exclusive artifact.heim-pc.nixos-activation-source write claim, T006 creates a content-addressed whole-source artifact and immutable manifest from the exact reviewed local integration tree. The manifest binds the exact T006 integration commit/tree, exact T001/T002 terminal commit identities and proven ancestor relations, archive/content digest, Control Release Set and lock/input identity; immediate independent re-hash/readback proves artifact contents match the reviewed source tree. Once fixed, this artifact—not any Git ref—is the durable source-bytes authority for successors.

T006 performs no git push and creates or updates no remote Git ref. Its Bureau-generated workspace branch is local/run-scoped only; T004 and T007 receive the reviewed source bytes through the content-addressed activation-source artifact and bind the exact T006 commit identity separately for ancestry verification.

The T006 terminal evidence designates the content-addressed activation-source artifact as T004's only build-source input and as T007's immutable integrated-source input, while also binding the exact local T006 commit that T007 must verify in the exclusively claimed Git object store to preserve ancestry. T005 does not consume or claim the T006 local revision as its workspace baseline. T004/T007 fail closed on any different artifact digest, manifest, source tree, commit identity or Control Release Set/lock identity; neither relies on a moving or remote T006 Git ref.

T006 performs no remote branch publication, main-branch merge, production NixOS activation, partitioning, formatting, LUKS/EFI/Secure-Boot/firmware mutation, reboot or equivalent production-cutover effect.

metadata.workspace_contract: Bureau run-scoped worktree and local non-main branch recorded in the execution envelope
